fact: In 2023-2024 partner funding paid for a StatEduc consultant, migration of the StatEduc database from MS Access to PostgreSQL with a move to online entry, training of regional and inspection staff on electronic questionnaires, and the start of pupil registration with a design of the platform that enrols pupils and generates matricule numbers.
title: Rapport final, Revue Sectorielle Conjointe de l'Education du Togo 2025
publisher: Ministère de l'Éducation du Togo (Secrétariat technique permanent du PSE)
